description: Admin UI surface for revoking and extending attestations in mcp_attestations table. Must provide: (1) List view of active attestations with server_name, verdict, issued_at, expires_at. (2) Revoke action with reason field. (3) Extend action with new valid_until date. (4) All writes via write_service POST :8772/write. (5) Audit log insertion on revoke/extend actions. (6) Confirmation dialogs for destructive actions.
